```{r}
# set up the color guide scheme #

# set up a matrix to rotate the coordinates
theta <- -pi/10
R <- matrix(c(cos(theta), -sin(theta), sin(theta), cos(theta)), nrow = 2)
rot_coords <- t(R %*% t(apply(domain[,c("x", "y")], 2, function(x){x - min(x)})))
# set up the continuous spatial color scheme
x_colfn <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "black"))
y_colfn <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "gold"))
domain$xcol <- x_colfn(nrow(domain))[as.numeric(cut(rot_coords[,1],breaks = nrow(domain)))]
domain$ycol <- y_colfn(nrow(domain))[as.numeric(cut(rot_coords[,2],breaks = nrow(domain)))]
for (i in 1:nrow(domain)) {
  domain$xycol[i] <- colorRampPalette(c(domain$xcol[i], domain$ycol[i]))(3)[2]
}


png(filename = "figures/nsw_biplot.png")
plot(vec2im(domain$xycol, domain$x, domain$y), valuesAreColors = T, box = F, main = "")
mtext("A: Biplot with Domain Color Guide", side = 3, line = 0.5, adj = 0, xpd = T)
par(xpd = T)
points(mB2$basis.functions$x, mB2$basis.functions$y, bg = mB2$basis.functions$xycol, pch = 21, cex = 1.2)
legend(x = 0.1, y = -0.1, legend = c("Basis function nodes", "Tree Locations"), pch = c(1, 4), bty = "n", xpd = T)
dev.off()


# function to add cols to the basis function nodes
get_bfs_cols <- function(x) {
  bfs <- if (!is.null(x$basis.functions)) x$basis.functions else x
  ext.win <- owin(range(c(domain$x, bfs$x)), range(c(domain$y, bfs$y)))
  bfs.pp <- ppp(x = bfs$x, y = bfs$y, window = ext.win)
  domain.pp <- ppp(x = domain$x, y = domain$y, window = ext.win)
  nn.bfs <- nncross(bfs.pp, domain.pp, what = "which")
  domain$xycol[nn.bfs]
}



bfs_cols_mlgcp = get_bfs_cols(mB2)

load("bfs.RDATA")
bfs_cols_default = get_bfs_cols(bfs)

load("bfs_oneq.RDATA")
bfs_cols_oneq = get_bfs_cols(bfs)

bfs_cols_all = list(

  glm_oneq = bfs_cols_oneq,
  glmnet_joint = bfs_cols_default,
  glmnet_individ_row = bfs_cols_default,
  glmnet_oneq = bfs_cols_oneq
)

load("dat_rename.RDATA")
species = unique(dat_rename$spid)


biplot_mlgcp <- function(u, lambda, species, bfs_cols, main = "") {
  
  # select species with largest loading magnitude
  load_strength <- sqrt(rowSums(lambda^2))
  selected_sp <- c(2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 14) # includes species 19
  
  # scale arrows to latent scores
  lambda_sel = lambda[selected_sp, , drop = FALSE]
  
  #make longest arrow 1.2 units long through taking max length of an arrow
  arrow_length = sqrt(rowSums(lambda_sel^2))
  arrow_scale = 2/max(arrow_length)
  
  par(pty = "s")
  plot(
    u[, 1], u[, 2],
    xlab = "LV1",
    ylab = "LV2",
    pch = 16,
    col = bfs_cols,
    asp = 1,
    xlim = c(-3, 3),
    ylim = c(-4, 2),
    main = main
  )
  
  arrows(
    x0 = 0, y0 = 0,
    arrow_scale * lambda_sel[, 1],
    arrow_scale * lambda_sel[, 2],
    length = 0.08
  )
  
  text(
    jitter(arrow_scale * lambda[selected_sp, 1], amount = 0.15),
    jitter(arrow_scale * lambda[selected_sp, 2], amount = 0.15),
    labels = species[selected_sp],
    pos = 4,
    cex = 0.7
  )

}

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = TRUE)
```
